privileged_info_for_vlm: The application is OpenBCI GUI v5.2.2. The data source must be set to 'PLAYBACK' mode. The specific file to be loaded is 'OpenBCI-EEG-S001-EyesOpen.txt'. This file contains 8 channels of real human EEG data from the PhysioNet EEGMMI dataset (Subject 1, Run 1). Success is defined by the 'Time Series' widget showing 8 channels of scrolling data while in Playback mode.
